test_train: test the train function that returns a dict of training modules for calculus differentiation
test_test: test the test function that returns a dict of testing modules for calculus differentiation
build_differentiate: build calculus differentiation questions that generate polynomial derivative problems with sympy answers
test_differentiate_univariate: test the differentiate_univariate function that generates univariate polynomial derivative problems
test_differentiate: test the differentiate function that generates multivariate polynomial derivative problems up to 4 variables
